name: node_handoff
description: Node handoff test vectors for GCP-7 (Gateway Coordination Protocol). Covers handoff request/response CoAP messages, OSCORE state transfer payloads, freshness state, sequence number handling, and RPL route update sequences.

vectors.name: handoff_request_minimal
vectors.description: GCP-7: Minimal handoff request with only required fields (node address and timestamp).

vectors.name: handoff_request_with_rssi
vectors.description: GCP-7: Handoff request with optional RSSI field indicating signal strength at new gateway.

vectors.name: handoff_request_roundtrip
vectors.description: GCP-7: Verify handoff request survives CBOR encode/decode roundtrip.

vectors.name: handoff_response_error_not_found
vectors.description: GCP-7: Error response when node is not found in source gateway registry.

vectors.name: handoff_response_error_busy
vectors.description: GCP-7: Error response when node is busy with active transaction.

vectors.name: handoff_response_error_auth_failed
vectors.description: GCP-7 SECURITY: Error when OSCORE authentication fails on handoff request.

vectors.name: handoff_response_error_malformed
vectors.description: GCP-7: Error when handoff request payload is malformed.

vectors.name: handoff_response_error_rate_limited
vectors.description: GCP-7 SECURITY: Error when handoff requests are rate-limited (DoS protection).

vectors.name: handoff_response_success_minimal
vectors.description: GCP-7: Minimal success response with required state fields.

vectors.name: handoff_response_success_full
vectors.description: GCP-7: Complete success response with OSCORE state, freshness, and parent list.

vectors.name: oscore_state_transfer
vectors.description: GCP-7: OSCORE security context state for handoff transfer including sequence and replay window.

vectors.name: oscore_state_with_id_context
vectors.description: GCP-7: OSCORE state with optional ID context field set.

vectors.name: freshness_state_transfer
vectors.description: GCP-7: DAO freshness tracking state for handoff transfer.

vectors.name: freshness_state_inactive
vectors.description: GCP-7: Freshness state for inactive node (no active_until field).

vectors.name: handoff_sequence_increment
vectors.description: GCP-7 SECURITY: After handoff, new gateway MUST increment sequence numbers to prevent replay.
vectors.increment_reason: Prevents acceptance of in-flight messages from before handoff as replays

vectors.name: rpl_route_update_after_handoff
vectors.description: GCP-7: After handoff completes, node sends DAO to establish route via new gateway.
update_steps: Node detects better RSSI from new_gateway
Node sends DAO to new_gateway (triggers handoff)
new_gateway confirms handoff to node via CoAP

vectors.name: handoff_protocol_flow_complete
vectors.description: GCP-7: Complete handoff protocol flow with all messages.

messages.description: Node sends DAO to new gateway (detected via RSSI improvement)
New gateway requests handoff from old gateway
Old gateway releases node, returns state
New gateway confirms handoff to node

final_state.reason: Sequence numbers incremented by 1 per GCP-7 security requirement

vectors.name: handoff_request_invalid_not_map
vectors.description: GCP-7: Reject handoff request that is CBOR array instead of map.

vectors.name: handoff_request_invalid_missing_timestamp
vectors.description: GCP-7: Reject handoff request missing required timestamp field.

vectors.name: handoff_request_invalid_truncated
vectors.description: GCP-7: Reject truncated CBOR payload.
